requirements.title: Network security, SOC and SIEM
requirements.guidance: A SOC with SIEM correlation, anti-malware, layered boundary defences, segmentation and device checks before network access.

requirements.title: API security
requirements.guidance: Authenticate and authorise API calls, protect message integrity and availability, and detect anomalies.

requirements.title: Security event collection and analysis
requirements.guidance: Collect and analyse security events to raise alerts proactively.

requirements.title: Anomaly monitoring
requirements.guidance: Monitor system components for anomalies that indicate malicious acts or errors.

requirements.title: Security event evaluation
requirements.guidance: Evaluate security events to decide whether they are incidents.

requirements.title: Visibility of access through logs and monitoring
requirements.guidance: Keep visibility on access to personal data through logs, monitoring and review, so unauthorised access can be detected, investigated and remediated.

requirements.title: Monitoring activities
requirements.guidance: Monitor networks and systems for anomalous behaviour and act on it.
